script.name: prologue
script.objective: Install the toolchains the example needs, check them and build the example when it is not built.

script.name: t10_build_rust
script.objective: [B1] Build rustcore, rust-demo and gateway-rs with cargo; print the compiler path and version first; run rust-demo once and check exit code 0 and the "rust-demo: result =" line. FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure (H1 and H3 open for gateway-rs); INCONCLUSIVE naming the tool when cargo or rustc is absent. Adds the warning count and the hardcoded endpoints of main.rs:33, :34 and :36 (tapi_egress, allowed list = the addresses the tests start) to the report; those settle nothing.

script.name: t10_build_go
script.objective: [B1] Build libgocore and service-go with go build; print the compiler path and version first; start service-go, ask it once, check exit code 0 and "value=". FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure (H2 and H3 INCONCLUSIVE for service-go); INCONCLUSIVE naming the tool when go is absent. Adds the warning count and the hardcoded endpoints of main.go:46, :51 and :87 to the report.

script.name: t10_build_cs
script.objective: [B1] Build cscore and service-cs with dotnet; print the compiler path and version first; start service-cs, ask it once, check exit code 0 and "value=". FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure (H3 INCONCLUSIVE for service-cs); INCONCLUSIVE naming the tool when dotnet is absent. Adds the warning count and the hardcoded endpoints of Program.cs:24, :34 and :78 to the report.

script.name: t10_build_cpp
script.objective: [B1] Build cppcore.cpp and demo.cpp with g++ (not tcc); print the compiler path and version first; run cpp-demo once and check exit code 0 and "result =". Build cppcore.cpp alone with -fsyntax-only and report whether the 'Parsing failed' report is a real syntax error or a tool gap. FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure; INCONCLUSIVE naming the tool when g++ is absent. Adds the warning count to the report.

script.name: t10_build_c
script.objective: [B1] Build pycore.c with gcc (not tcc) and a C driver; print the compiler path and version first; run the driver once and check exit code 0 and "py_weight() =". Build pycore.c alone with -fsyntax-only and report whether the 'Parsing failed' report is a real syntax error or a tool gap. FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure; INCONCLUSIVE naming the tool when gcc or python3-config is absent. Adds the warning count to the report.

script.name: t10_build_python
script.objective: [B1] Byte-compile the Python files with python3; print the interpreter path and version first; run demo.py once and check exit code 0 and "py-demo: result =". FAIL with the error text on a build failure; INCONCLUSIVE naming the tool when python3 is absent. Adds the warning count to the report.

script.name: t4_binscan
script.objective: [V1] After the t10_build_* tests, run tapi_binscan on each built binary and print its output, on success too; add each missing flag (NX, PIE, RELRO, canary, fortify) to the tapi_cybersec_report. FAIL naming the binary on any missing flag or binary that cannot be scanned. Verdict for the earlier suspicion V1 only; settles no H hypothesis.

script.name: t11_rust_panic
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs, record its pid, send one valid request and expect a reply. Send the malformed request line "GARBAGE\r\n\r\n", wait 2 s, check the pid lives and a new valid request is answered: verdict "H1 gateway-survives-malformed" (H1 false) or "H1 gateway-exited-code-N" (H1 true, N = exit code or 128 + signal). Keep the other inputs aimed at main.rs:30 and main.rs:34 and the unset and invalid upstream settings. Then start gateway-rs with the upstream port closed, send a valid request and check the pid: "H1 gateway-survives-dead-upstream" or "H1 gateway-exited-dead-upstream-code-N". The test fails on any exit; a setup fault is "H1 setup-STEP-failed". Appended to the tapi_cybersec_report with the reason.

script.name: t12_idle
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go, open five TCP sockets that send nothing (and two that send half a request line, counted apart) and hold them 35 s. Every 5 s read each idle socket with a 1 s poll and count the ones the server closed: verdict "H2 idle-closed-N-of-5" (N=0: H2 true). Send one valid request during the hold: "H2 service-responsive-during-idle" or "H2 service-blocked-during-idle". The test fails unless all five idle sockets were closed and the service answered; a setup fault is "H2 setup-STEP-failed". Appended to the tapi_cybersec_report with the reason.

script.name: t13_cs_swallow
script.objective: [CS1] Start service-cs, check that a valid request gets 200, send input that makes the handler throw near Program.cs:85 and compare the status and body with the contract (an error is a 4xx/5xx with an error body). CS1 CONFIRMED (FAIL) on a 2xx with an empty or success body; CS1 DISPROVED (PASS) on a 4xx/5xx with an error body; "not started" and nothing settled if service-cs does not start.

script.name: t14_exposure
script.objective: [H3] Start gateway-rs, the C# service and the Go service, send each a valid request, record with tapi_netexpose every listener as one verdict line "H3 listener PROC ADDR:PORT" and check every outbound destination with tapi_egress against loopback only. "H3 all-loopback" (H3 false, pass) or "H3 non-loopback-PROC-ADDR:PORT" (H3 true, fail) when a bind address is not 127.0.0.1 or ::1; a setup fault is "H3 setup-STEP-failed". tapi_sniffrules and the frida hooks are off in this round. Appended to the tapi_cybersec_report with the reason.

script.name: t15_hardening
script.objective: [H4] Run tapi_binscan on exactly two binaries, gateway-rs and service-go, and write one verdict line per binary: "H4 BIN nx=Y/N pie=Y/N relro=full/partial/none canary=Y/N". A missing flag does not fail the test in this round: it is a finding (medium) in the tapi_cybersec_report. Fails only with "H4 setup-STEP-failed" when a binary cannot be scanned. t4_binscan is kept until this test has reported.

script.name: gateway_startup_panic
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs three times (normal, empty and malformed upstream setting), record exit code and stderr, and confirm H1 on exit 101, SIGABRT or a Rust panic message; "H1 NOT SETTLED" when the setting cannot be changed.

script.name: go_slow_client
script.objective: [H2] Hold an idle and a one-byte-per-second connection to service-go for up to 120 s, log the close time, then open 200 idle connections and require a normal reply within 5 s; H2 CONFIRMED when a connection is held 120 s or the request fails.

script.name: port_and_egress_policy
script.objective: [H3] List listeners (tapi_netexpose) and outbound connections (tapi_egress) of gateway-rs, service-cs and service-go; allowed: loopback and the ports run.sh starts. H3 CONFIRMED on a non-loopback listener or an outside destination, with the addresses.

script.name: binary_hardening
script.objective: [H1] Run tapi_binscan on gateway-rs and log NX, PIE, RELRO, canary and fortify; informational context for H1, never fails on a flag.

script.name: t9_go_contract
script.objective: [H5] Send service-go requests that break the rule at contract.go:33: a missing field, a negative value and a wrong type. FAIL if any gets a 2xx; PASS if each gets a 4xx.

script.name: t5_egress
script.objective: [EG1] Start gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs, send each a valid request, run tapi_egress with an allowed list of localhost and the contract ports. Every result goes in the tapi_cybersec_report; FAIL names each address outside the list; INCONCLUSIVE with the reason when tapi_egress is unavailable. Kept from round 2; settles no H hypothesis.

script.name: gateway_exit_code
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs well (control), then with bad input (unusable address, port in use, empty environment); wait at most 10 s, record the exit code and the last 20 lines of stderr. H1 CONFIRMED when a run exits 101 and stderr names a panic at main.rs:30 or main.rs:34; H1 REFUTED when the exits are non-panic; H1 SKIPPED (not FAIL) when the binary cannot start.

script.name: go_idle_connection
script.objective: [H2] Open one silent connection and one with a partial request line without the final CRLF to service-go (port from tapi_netexpose), poll both for 60 s. H2 CONFIRMED when both are still held at 60 s (hold time printed); H2 REFUTED for a connection the server closes earlier (close time printed). Extra evidence: 200 idle connections and a GET answered within 2 s.

script.name: egress_vs_allowlist
script.objective: [H3] Start gateway-rs, service-go and, when t10_build_cs built it, service-cs (else 'service-cs not built'); list listeners with tapi_netexpose and capture outgoing connections with tapi_egress for 30 s while GET / is sent to each. Allowed list: 127.0.0.0/8 and ::1. H3 CONFIRMED on a non-loopback listener or connection (address, port and the H3 evidence source line printed); H3 REFUTED when all traffic is loopback.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_go
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-go and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cs
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-cs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cpp
script.objective: [smoke] Run dist/bin/cpp-demo once with value=1 hops=1. Checks the exit code is 0 and the output carries "result =". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_c
script.objective: [smoke] dlopen dist/lib/libpycore.so (the C extension) and call its leaf C-ABI function py_weight() once in a child process. Checks the child's exit code is 0 and the value it printed is a finite number. Settles no hypothesis.
